name: SEIS Framework Decision Record
decisionRule: Do not migrate to Next.js, Astro, or another framework until static constraints create measurable maintainability risk.

candidateFrameworks.fit: application routes, server components, API surfaces, and richer product workflows
candidateFrameworks.risk: dependency growth and heavier local development loops

candidateFrameworks.fit: content-heavy editorial surfaces, static-first delivery, and island-based interactivity
candidateFrameworks.risk: migration work may not pay off until content volume grows

candidateFrameworks.fit: current low-power portfolio, governance, locale, and release surface
candidateFrameworks.risk: manual route maintenance can grow if case studies multiply

acceptanceCriteria: case study count or route complexity exceeds static maintenance comfort
content loading needs shared templates instead of hand-edited HTML
3D or cinematic surfaces need isolated progressive enhancement boundaries
server-side API needs become confirmed rather than speculative
migration keeps accessibility, reduced motion, and release rollback contracts intact
rollbackPath: keep portable JSON content registries as source of truth
preserve the static build and server package scripts until replacement checks pass
ship framework migration on an isolated branch before merging into the protected branch
